# Synergy Brix

> Synergy Brix is a software development and digital solutions company based in Vasai West, Maharashtra, India. The company builds websites, custom software, web applications, business automation, dashboards, APIs, SaaS products, cloud solutions, and database systems for businesses.

Synergy Brix serves organizations in Vasai-Virar, Mumbai, and beyond. The team works from business requirements and existing workflows to define an agreed scope, design and implement a solution, test it, and support deployment.
